subject: general
question: What was the new Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) level after the December 2024 cut?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4.0%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, in its **bi-monthly monetary policy** review announced in **December 2024**, decided to reduce the **Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR)**.
 
• The **CRR** was reduced by **50 basis points (bps)**, moving it from the previous level of **4.50%** to the new level of **4.00%**.
 
• This decision was announced by the **RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das** to address the prevailing liquidity conditions in the banking system.
 
• The reduction in the ratio is estimated to release primary liquidity worth approximately **Rs 1.16 lakh crore** into the Indian banking system, providing banks with more funds for lending.
